finding.summary: Worked example. The public A2A agent-card census record published on Hugging Face is checked for origin, integrity and time of existence by a procedure anyone can run.

claim.statement: The record.json served by the Hugging Face dataset csoai/a2a-card-census at revision c6331de14886d72bf3e0ac7026055d80431cce82 has sha256 b290b53d...176c, and that digest is inside a payload that verifies under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1.
claim.scope: Origin and integrity of these bytes only. Not the accuracy of the census, not the behaviour of any agent it lists, not the trustworthiness of the signer.

declared_failure_modes: The DID document is fetched live: a key rotated or replaced at csoai.org would change what verifies; the key is not pinned by this record.
Check 7 trusts one public block explorer for the block header; `ots verify` against a local Bitcoin node is stronger.
Canonicalisation is key-sorted compact JSON; a payload containing floats would need a stated number encoding.
test.noise_floor: Not applicable: the checks are exact byte and signature comparisons.

negative_control.description: Three altered inputs run through the same checks in the same run: a trailing byte appended to the signed preimage, the artifact digest replaced with zeros, and one bit flipped in record.json.

result.reason: Checks 1-4 hold and all three altered inputs were rejected. The stored .ots proof binds to the record digest and holds three pending calendar commitments; on request the calendars returned Bitcoin attestations at heights 968527 and 968533, and both commitments matched those block headers' merkle roots as served by blockstream.info. OpenTimestamps state as published: PENDING_CALENDAR_COMMITMENT; as re-checked: upgrade available, not stored.

evidence.name: census payload_sha256 (the digest the Ed25519 signature covers)

limits: A signature proves who signed these bytes, not that anything in them is true.

This re-verification record is itself UNSIGNED and unregistered: it is an example of the shape. The signature it checks is the census record's, carried in the csoai.signed-run/0.1 envelope, not a COSE or DSSE envelope.
No watcher is running on this record today, so watch.state is NOT_WATCHED rather than CURRENT.
The published .ots file still holds pending commitments; the Bitcoin attestation was fetched on request and has not been written back.
